hebrew: תְּפִלָה לְעָנִי כִּי יַעֲטֹף, וְלִפְנֵי הַ’ יִשְׁפֹּךְ שִׂיחוֹ, הַ’ שִׁמְעָה תְפִלָתִי, וְשַׁוְעָתִי אֵלֶיךָ תָבוֹא, אַל תַּסְתֵּר פָּנֶיךָ מִמֶנִי, בְּיוֹם צַר לִי
translation:
A Prayer of the afflicted (other translations - poor or lowly), when he fainteth, and poureth out his complaint before the LORD.

O Lord, hear my prayer, and let my cry come unto Thee.

Hide not Thy face from me in the day of my distress.

Psalm 102:1-3

Translation source: Jewish Publication Society Bible (1917) (public domain)
